thread:
incident-bot: [SEV2] Multiple OOMs observed on inference-prod nodes (paged-attn / kvcache). Containers `inference-runtime` crashed repeatedly on gpu-14; nvml/CUDA errors in dmesg. Paging + fragmentation trending up. Pager: eng-oncall.

maria: seeing a slow steady climb in kvcache resident bytes on gpu-14 — ~78% -> 96% over ~3h. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/inference/d/kvcache

soren: @maria thanks. any particular model/route skew? long-contexts?

maria: yep, long-context Llama-seq workloads spiking. batch merges + prefix prefetching causing large kv resident sets. `kvcache.entries` and `kvcache.prefetch_bytes` both climbing. I pushed a temporary eviction ratio bump on canary: `kubectl set env deploy/inference-runtime KV_EVICT_RATIO=0.5 -n prod`

ryan: logs show `CUerror: out of memory` then `nvml: driver lost` right before container crash. node flapped once. cordoning node now.

tara: cordoned gpu-14, starting `kubectl drain gpu-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to move pods. tagging infra to replace HW.

maria: drain in progress. restarting a small subset of inference-runtime pods with `--kv-evict=aggressive` flag. sample: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-runtime -n prod```

soren: please canary the restart (5 pods) and watch `kvcache.resident_bytes`, `paged_allocator.fragmentation`. avoid a full fleet restart.

oncall-bot: Handoff: @tara -> @soren (day-eng) at 1744444600. Added tag `customer-impact:possible-latency-502s`.

soren: customer impact: some /v1/chat requests returned 502s during node flap window 1744444300-1744444400. support notified for affected tenants.

ryan: capturing nvml/dmesg and container logs now. example grep: ```kubectl -n prod logs inference-runtime-abc | grep -i oom || true``` and pulling `dmesg` + NVML logs for upload.

maria: immediate mitigations applied: 1) increase KV eviction aggressiveness, 2) reduce per-request KV prefetch window to 2 shards, 3) enable prefetched-kv cull. patched via configmap: ```kubectl -n prod patch cm inference-config --patch '{"data":{"kv_evict_ratio":"0.5","kv_prefetch_shards":"2","kv_prefetch_cull":"true"}}'```

tara: infra replacing gpu-14; node replacement ETA ~12m.

soren: plan: stabilize (drain/replace), canary rollout with aggressive eviction, monitor `oom_kills`, `kvcache.resident_bytes`, fallback to smaller model variant routing if OOMs continue. If fragmentation doesn't reduce, escalate to eng-runtime for allocator compaction patch.

maria: added short-term alert rule: `sum(increase(oom_kills_total[5m])) > 0` to paging alerting and lowered SLO thresholds for routing circuit-breakers.

ryan: collecting a core dump for one crashed container; uploading to S3: s3://redwood-dumps/oom/1744444444/ (will add link when upload finishes).

soren: action items: maria -> confirm eviction effect; ryan -> upload logs + core; tara -> confirm node replacement done; maria -> escalate to eng-runtime if fragmentation doesn't drop in 30m.

maria: eviction tweak appears to be reversing growth after ~7m — resident percent trending down 96% -> 88%. continuing to monitor.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2025-174444 (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2025-174444). Handoff reminder: review mitigation in 30m.

tara: node replacement completed, pods rescheduled, infra side shows healthy.

soren: closing the immediate mitigation loop. next steps: postmortem draft, heap/allocator profile run, schedule allocator compaction/defrag work in eng-runtime backlog, consider routing defaults to smaller model for long-context heavy tenants. tagging @eng-runtime.

maria: confirmed support outreach to impacted customers and initial mitigation note posted. marking as mitigated for now; will keep watch for regressions.
notes: short live-mitigation coordination thread for kvcache/paged-attn slow memory creep -> OOMs, node cordon/drain, canary eviction tweak, node replace, customer impact flagged.
